about:
NewYork Cables operates from Saddle Brook, New Jersey, where it has supplied networking infrastructure for over 19 years. The company was founded with a single goal: to make quality networking simple and accessible for businesses and IT professionals.

The product line centers on bulk Ethernet cables — Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6a in both plenum and riser ratings — alongside multimode and singlemode fiber optic cables. The catalog also includes keystone jacks, patch panels, wall plates, RJ45 connectors, and fiber optic patch cords. Every item undergoes strict quality testing before shipment. In the past 12 months the company has processed more than 20,000 orders and serves over 1.3 million customers across all 50 states.

Customers span residential, commercial, and industrial networking projects, with a strong presence in data-center installations and CCTV or professional surveillance systems. The company also supports IT network integrators and contractors who need certified cabling that passes Fluke testing and meets TIA standards.

NewYork Cables emphasizes its industry expertise, broad product range, and a reported 95 percent customer satisfaction rate. The firm highlights same-day shipping on stocked items, flexible payment options, and dedicated technical support as key differentiators.
